name: Icefiend

variantInfo.name: Icefiend
notes: NPC ids 4813 (Ice Mountain) and 3140; combat level 13, 15 Hitpoints, max hit 2, 4-tick.
Attacks with magical melee (Protect from Magic reduces the damage).
100% weak to fire spells; Defence 12 with all defensive bonuses +0.
A level-18 variant exists at some spawns; the default pins the level-13 Ice Mountain form.

locationComparison.name: Ice Mountain
notes: Around 10 Icefiend spawns on top of Ice Mountain, north-west of Falador / west of Edgeville.
Icefiends can be safespotted behind rocks; multi and cannon are not wiki-stated and treated conservatively as false.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 293 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Icefiends is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned by Turael (15-20) and Spria (15-20) in this dataset; no Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Their combat-level threshold is around 20.
100% weak to fire spells: cast Fire Strike/Bolt/Wave (fire-battlestaff plugin weapon). weakness.style MAGIC / element fire.
Attacks with magical melee, so Protect from Magic reduces incoming damage; max hit is only 2.
A level-18 Icefiend variant exists at some spawns; the default variant pins the level-13 Ice Mountain form.
recommendedMethod: Icefiends are a low-level Turael/Spria task on top of Ice Mountain (and the God Wars Dungeon entrance). They are 100% weak to fire spells, so cast a fire spell (Fire Strike, Bolt or Wave) with a fire staff for the fastest kills. Defence is only 12 and their max hit is 2 (magical melee), so Protect from Magic and a couple of food are ample. They can be safespotted behind the rocks on the mountain.
